Which schools can I explore in Nobleton?

Nobleton Public School and St. Mary Catholic Elementary School provide official information for local families. Start with the school websites, then check eligibility and attendance boundaries with the relevant school board.

Nobleton Public School

Find current school information through the York Region District School Board.

Visit Nobleton Public School

St. Mary Catholic Elementary School

The school’s contact page lists its address as 75 Greenside Drive, Nobleton.

Visit St. Mary’s contact page

Before you choose a home or register

Confirm address-specific attendance boundaries, admission requirements, transportation eligibility and registration dates directly with the board. A nearby school is not a guarantee of admission.

Local school contacts at a glance

Nobleton Public School serves Junior Kindergarten through Grade 8 at 13375 Highway 27. Its published office number is 905-859-4590. St. Mary Catholic Elementary School is at 75 Greenside Drive; its office number is 905-859-3336.

Nobleton Public School contact detailsSt. Mary contact details

Use the exact home address when checking boundaries

The York Region District School Board reviews attendance areas and warns that some new residents may be directed to a different school because of enrolment pressures. Use the board’s elementary or secondary boundary tool, then confirm the result with the school before making plans around a particular address.

Check public-school boundaries

Questions for your registration call

  • Which school and program serve this address for the intended school year?
  • Which eligibility documents and proof of address will the school require?
  • Where can we confirm transportation, before-school care and after-school care?

Local details checked November 9, 2026 against the official sources linked above. Confirm schedules and availability before visiting.

Something changed? Email info@nobleton.ca with the official source so we can review an update.
